title: VALDIVIA, LA PERLA DEL SUR DE CHILE — official destination page
publisher: UTMB World Series / Torrencial Chile by UTMB
claims: Valdivia was founded in 1552 on the banks of the Calle-Calle river.
The city's river network includes the Valdivia, Calle-Calle, Cau-Cau and Cruces rivers.
The event describes the Valdivian rainforest (Selva Valdiviana) as one of the region's defining landscapes.
The page quotes Parque Oncol as a coastal forest remnant with annual rainfall above 3,500 mm, strong winds and high atmospheric humidity.
The event states that in southern Chile winter and rain add a distinct dimension to trail running, including persistent rain and swollen rivers.
